body: Ported REDGARDEN's S144-06 box-rig into GFD's own battlegrounds_gui client (the real DragonsNShit MOBA client). Same vendored GOLDENBAND C sampler, same hand-authored idle/walk BVH clips through the real gbtool pipeline, same 5-joint forward-kinematics rig, wired into ARENA_HERO_TYLER's draw call with a safe fallback if assets fail to load. Live-verified under Xvfb in this client specifically -- Tyler renders as a real multi-box rig distinct from Unicorn. mud rebuilt per this repo's own tracked-binary convention. GoblinFoxDragon commits 18049ef/450ddae. Full plan: docs2/GOLDENBAND_INTEGRATION_NORTHSTAR.md.
title: S144-06 port: GOLDENBAND box-rig drives Tyler's animation in battlegrounds_gui
